description: Search Arctic White's catalog of lab consumables (microplates, deep well plates, reservoirs, sealing mats and films, tubes, filter plates, lab equipment) by catalog number, a competitor's part number, name, well count or type. Returns SKUs, published prices (or 'pricing on request'), stock and product links.

limit.description: Most results to return (1 to 25, default 10)

query.description: What to search for, e.g. '96 deep well 2 mL', 'AWLS-219006', 'sealing mat 384'

name: search_products

results.description: Matching products, best match first. Empty when nothing matches.

quote_only.description: True for a custom made, quote-only product: it has no price and cannot be checked out; use request_quote

replaces.description: The competitor part this product replaces, when found through that part number

standard_alternative.description: For a quote-only product, the closest standard product sold today; null otherwise or when none is set

items.description: One orderable option of the product.

availability.description: Stock status: in_stock, backorder (available to order) or out_of_stock

option.description: Option name (e.g. Sterile), null when the product has one option

price.description: Price as shown, e.g. $246.00, or Pricing on request

price_usd.description: Published price per selling unit in USD, null when priced on request

title: Search products
